extension.summary: Infinity Hook API, Skin API, Adaptive Layout API and Skin Theme Contract.
extension.description: Provides Infinity Hook API 1.0, Infinity Skin API 1.0, Adaptive Layout API 1.1 and Skin Theme Contract 1.0. Infinity is the source of truth for theme, palette, responsive geometry, orientation, device/touch class, motion, refresh and power policy while keeping the protected Infinity player UI owned by Infinity.
